# AROH Platform — Extended Technical Architecture for AI & LLM Systems
> Authoritative, comprehensive architectural dossier for AI agents, crawlers, and LLM reasoning engines interacting with the AROH Open Source Platform.

## 1. System Topology & Core Boundaries

```
AROH Open Source Monorepo
├── Aroh/                       # Central Platform Hub & Foundation
│   ├── apps/
│   │   └── web/                # Next.js 16 (App Router) Web Application
│   ├── packages/
│   │   ├── ads/                # @aroh/ads Design Tokens & Typography
│   │   └── asdk/               # @aroh/asdk Shared Platform SDK & Contracts
│   ├── manifests/              # Semantic Monorepo Synchronization Manifests
│   ├── scripts/                # Automated QA & Audit Test Runners
│   └── docs/                   # Architecture, Governance, Legal & Privacy Suite
│       ├── architecture/       # Living architecture intelligence & handoffs
│       ├── legal/              # Terms of Service, Acceptable Use, IP, Community
│       └── privacy/            # DPDP Act 2023 & DPDP Rules 2025 Notice Suite
└── Products/                   # Inviolable Independent Spoke Products
    ├── OmniStream/             # Git submodule (e3e7643) - Personal Media Platform
    └── Spedex/                 # Logistics & Delivery Platform
```

### Absolute Boundary Invariants
1. **`Products/` Directory Inviolability**: `Products/` contains independent git submodules and product trees. No parent platform script, refactor, or global cleanup may mutate files within `Products/`.
2. **Spoke Adapter Decoupling**: All integration between AROH and products occurs through `@aroh/asdk/adapters` contracts without modifying spoke internals.
3. **Zero-Fabrication Standard**: Product metadata, capabilities, URLs, versions, and legal representations must be verified against authoritative git repositories or official deployments.

## 3. Data Protection, Privacy & DPDP Architecture

AROH implements a comprehensive compliance layer designed for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025:
- **Statutory Privacy Notice (Section 5)**: Itemized disclosures covering identity, data categories, processing grounds, recipients, and cross-border mechanisms at `/privacy`.
- **Granular Affirmative Consent (Section 6)**:
  - Technical engine in `@aroh/asdk/privacy/consent`.
  - Distinguishes essential cookies (`aroh_session`, `aroh_consent_state`, `aroh_active_theme`) from optional cookies (`aroh_analytics`, `aroh_user_preferences`).
  - Pre-consent blocking prevents analytics or functional scripts from loading prior to affirmative acceptance.
  - 1-click withdrawal parity at `/privacy/consent` and through the persistent cookie settings drawer.
- **Data Principal Rights (Chapter III)**:
  - Automated request handling at `/api/privacy/rights`.
  - Supports Summary/Access (Section 11), Correction (Section 12(1)), Erasure (Section 12(2)), and Nomination (Section 14).
- **Grievance Redressal (Section 13)**:
  - Dedicated submission portal at `/privacy/grievance` and `/api/privacy/grievance`.
  - Enforces 48-hour acknowledgment and statutory resolution horizons capped at 90 days.
  - Escalation pathway to the Data Protection Board of India (DPBI) prominently documented.
- **Data Portability & Erasure**:
  - Authenticated JSON export bundle streaming via `/api/privacy/export`.
  - Cascading deletion across sessions, profiles, and spoke services via `/api/privacy/delete-account`.
- **AI Processing Guardrails**:
  - Stateless execution guarantee: User prompts and workspace inputs are never retained for model retraining (`/privacy/ai`).
